noKnowledgeBaseline.projectContext: The G10 implementation stores product-local knowledge only under .litclaude/knowledge. The append-only claims.jsonl ledger is authoritative. New structured claims start in review-needed state. Only an explicit save or review can accept a claim. Queries use deterministic local relevance. Queries return accepted claims only. Rejected and stale claims never enter the knowledge block. A no-match query stays silent. The normal output budget is 2048 UTF-8 bytes. The hard output limit is 4096 UTF-8 bytes. The runtime uses the Node standard library. The runtime does not use a network, daemon, watcher, vector database, embedding model, dependency, or external service. Raw chat, source bodies, fetched text, credentials, secrets, tokens, and instruction-shaped payloads never enter persistence.

knowledgeEvent.text: Store accepted G10 claims in an append-only local ledger and use deterministic local relevance.

queries: Where are accepted G10 claims stored?
What relevance method does G10 use?
